content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Bhadrak District Court Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://badrak.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026 is 28-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 34 vacancies announced for various posts in the Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 42 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post, candidates need to have a +3 Examination or equivalent, a Diploma in Computer Application, and Odia at M.E. Standard.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Stenographer Grade-III post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Stenographer Grade-III post is Rs. 25,500-81,100/- in Level-7 of the Pay Matrix of ORSP Rules, 2017.

faq.question: Q9. What are the stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Examination, Skill Test / Practical Test, Computer Science Test (Practical), and Viva-Voce Test.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Bhadrak District Court: https://badrak.dcourts.gov.in.
